csv_scope_of_work: The City of La Quinta (City) seeks proposals fro.m qualified firms to provide Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accessibility Compliance Assessment and Transition Plan Consulting services to conduct a comprehensive ADA self-evaluation of City digital properties, programs, services, activities, facilities, public right-of-way, etc., and develop an ADA Transition Plan.

title: Consultant for Accessibility Assessment and Transition Plan
short_description: ADA compliance assessment and transition planning for City of La Quinta facilities and services.

services: ADA accessibility compliance assessment, self-evaluation, transition planning, and related consulting services; requested disciplines include civil engineering, surveying/GIS/mapping, and planning/master planning.
